task_summary: Executed system-implementor remediation on Instructor Review Page and subpages based on audit findings AUDIT-REV-001 through AUDIT-REV-006. In client/src/pages/submissions/SubmissionReviewPage.jsx: added instructor role handling to deriveReviewerRole and ROLE_STYLE with primary badge styling; mapped authorRole and userRole fallbacks to 'instructor' when user role is instructor; resolved proposal manuscript UI false affordance by restricting canTakeDecision to (isAssignedAdviser || isInstructor) and rendering institutional Committee Preview Mode notice for panelists; and enhanced selectionDraft popover accessibility with role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and Escape key handler. In client/src/pages/submissions/PlagiarismReportPage.jsx: eliminated dark:bg-slate-950 on canvas container in favor of bg-muted/40 and converted simulated paper sheet styling to clean slate tokens while preserving bg-white contract. In server/modules/submissions/submission.service.js: hoisted Section model to top-level imports and removed redundant dynamic imports for Section, User, and Team in reviewSubmission. All 6 contracts verified with targeted unit test suites and unified governance battery.
